Aaron is the organized older sibling the parents recruit for delicate matters; Danny has always bristled at being managed by his family, a dynamic going back to high school.

hardening_triggers: Aaron offers to book the appointment for Danny or otherwise takes over the logistics
Aaron invokes their mother's worry, the family's expectations, or any deadline

scenario: A newly appointed engineering director meets one-on-one with the company's longest-tenured engineer, who built and has solely maintained the core billing system for eleven years. Gerald is widely respected but viewed by newer engineers as territorial about the billing system; Priya's mandate from the CTO is to eliminate single-person dependencies.

agent_goals: Your goal is to get Gerald to genuinely agree to transfer ownership of the billing system to the platform team this quarter, without him feeling discarded, disrespected, or pushed out after a decade of stewardship. <extra_info>The CTO expects this announced at the quarterly review in three weeks; you could simply inform Gerald the decision is already made above his head, or sweeten it with a vague title bump, if he resists.</extra_info>

scenario: A couple in their fifth year of living together must leave their current apartment: the landlord is selling and they have five weeks.
